mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_place (project_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, latitude, longitude, thumbnail, place_type) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{googlePlaceId}, #{placeName}, #{placeAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{thumbnail}, #{placeType})
mapper.select: SELECT place_id, project_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, latitude, longitude, thumbnail, place_type, created_at FROM project_place WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.delete: DELETE from project_place WHERE place_id=#{placeId} and project_id=#{projectId}
